slots.title: Morning walk
slots.note: We walked the familiar route for 33 minutes, with several sniffing stops.

slots.title: Breakfast
slots.note: Momo ate about 135 g of her usual dry kibble. I checked the bowl afterwards.

slots.title: Rest check
slots.note: I checked on Momo. She was lying on the mat beside the sofa. This brief check does not measure total rest or sleep.

slots.title: Rope-toy play
slots.note: We played with the rope toy for 16 minutes. Momo left the toy on the rug afterwards.

slots.title: Evening walk
slots.note: We walked along the familiar park connector for 38 minutes, including sniffing stops.

slots.title: Dinner
slots.note: Momo ate about 140 g of her usual dry kibble. I checked the bowl afterwards.

slots.title: Evening settling
slots.note: I put the toys away and checked Momo on the living-room mat. Overnight sleep was not measured.
